thread.title: After Years Of Outperformance, Semiconductors Approach Another Bullish Breakout (SMH)

author: Tom Reese
title: After Years Of Outperformance, Semiconductors Approach Another Bullish Breakout (SMH)
text:
After Years Of Outperformance, Semiconductors Approach Another Bullish Breakout (SMH)   6:49am NYSE:SMH 
Technical analyst Chris Kimble examines the long-term chart for a popular semiconductor ETF and finds a potential bullish breakout in the works. 
Since the 2009 lows, would you rather have owned Semiconductors (SMH) or the S&P 500? Since the 2009 lows, Semiconductors are up 550%, more than double the returns of the S&P. This very strong index is now making an attempt to “Escape” from where it was back in 2000! 
SMH has remained inside of rising channel (A) since the lows in 2009. The near vertical rally since it hit the support back in 2016, has it attempting to escape above the top of rising channel (A) and the highs of 2000 at (2), at the same time. 
Below looks at FAANG stocks and the S&P 500 that we share with members each week. As you can see “All” of them remain inside rising channels. NFLX and AMZN are attempting channel breakouts and AAPL is attempting to break out above old highs. Full disclosure; Members bought Apple as it was testing rising support at the 2/9 lows (up 14%) and will add to the position if it breaks above old highs. 
If SMH is able to accomplish a dual breakout at (2) in the top chart, it would be good for it, FAANG stocks and the broad market. Keep an eye on this leading sector friends, what it does here should be important for portfolio construction going forward! 
The VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF ( SMH ) was unchanged in premarket trading Wednesday. Year-to-date, SMH has gained 11.74%, versus a 2.26% rise in the benchmark S&P 500 index during the same period. 
SMH currently has an ETF Daily News SMART Grade of A (Strong Buy) , and is ranked #9 of 60 ETFs in the Technology Equities ETFs category.
